preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: The list a must contain n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must describe a valid tree with n vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str((P * pow(Q, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD)
postconditions.description: The output must be the expected value of the function f(u, v) represented as P·Q - 1 modulo 10^9 + 7.
